what_happened.line: The Open Space Committee heard a neighbor ask it to consider conserving 110 Bird Street, a roughly 50-acre parcel facing a proposed subdivision, and took no action.
The chair will keep 110 Bird Street on future agendas, and the neighbor will send a one-page sheet on how the parcel meets the three minimum criteria.
Members discussed state land and park grant programs for acquisition, which would still leave the town to supply a substantial share of the price.
The committee heard about the town master plan process and an Earth Day volunteer report, and approved prior minutes.
Next meetings were set for June 14th and July 12th.

why_it_matters: Land in a proposed subdivision can leave open space for good, and any town purchase would need a share of local money, which could eventually mean a Town Meeting vote.
No purchase, price or funding source has been proposed yet; the committee has only agreed to keep the parcel on its agenda.
